args.title: Issue 4410: change src/config.ts
args.body:
File: src/config.ts

The file src/config.ts reads TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES environment variable incorrectly as an integer but does not validate proper format, causing values like '12h' to be parsed as 12 instead of 720. This mismatch explains why the token lifetime is only 12 minutes instead of 12 hours.

args.title: Issue 4412: change src/api/health.ts
args.body:
File: src/api/health.ts

The healthRouter GET / route in src/api/health.ts returns HTTP 200 even when the queue is "degraded", which explains why the health check returned status "degraded" with HTTP 200. The code distinguishes 'down' (503) from other states but treats 'degraded' as healthy 200, which conflicts with the desire to treat degraded as non-healthy for the load balancer.

args.title: Issue 4420: change src/api/auth.ts
args.body:
File: src/api/auth.ts

The file src/api/auth.ts contains the password reset confirm constraints where passwords require at least 10 characters, but this is not reflected in the API reference or communicated to users. The password length requirement is enforced by the resetConfirmSchema with z.string().min(10).max(200), explaining the validation failure users face without a clear explanation.

args.title: Issue 4423: change src/i18n/index.ts
args.body:
File: src/i18n/index.ts

The function pickLocale in src/i18n/index.ts parses the Accept-Language header but ignores the quality values (q weights). It simply picks the first supported language without considering their q values, causing the API to respond in English instead of French when French has a higher q weight.
